title: Become Present
coreMove: Presence is not a mood; it is attention, awareness, and nonjudgment applied to the person or problem in front of you before reaction takes over.

exampleSpecs.audience: Readers learning to separate presence from looking attentive
exampleSpecs.stakes: A trainee can either hide confusion or use it as the material for clearer attention.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Chase's confusion in the signal room becomes the lesson in attention, awareness, and nonjudgment.

exampleSpecs.audience: Readers who mistake effortful concentration for full presence
exampleSpecs.stakes: A partner's safety depends on seeing the rope, the climber, and the belayer's own tension.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Apolline shows the same belay station with one variable changed: attention, awareness, and nonjudgment working together.

exampleSpecs.domain: porch mail slot review of family notes
exampleSpecs.audience: Readers reviewing a small miss without making it a trial
exampleSpecs.stakes: A quiet find can turn blame into a practical repair for the next dinner.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Owen reviews existing notes by the porch mail slot and one detail shifts the meaning of the dinner miss.

exampleSpecs.audience: Readers whose thoughts sprint while the body looks still
exampleSpecs.stakes: The inner argument can either take over the practice or become something Maya can observe.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Maya works through attention, awareness, and nonjudgment with no external dialogue.

exampleSpecs.audience: Readers allocating scarce attention before pressure starts
exampleSpecs.stakes: A volunteer schedule will either protect attention for people or surrender it to stimulation.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Mateo allocates attention in the health tent before any action happens.

exampleSpecs.audience: Readers facing a live tradeoff between speed and full contact
exampleSpecs.stakes: Both available options cost Naomi something, so the choice reveals what governs her attention.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Naomi faces the chapter's only two-bad-options decision inside the welding booth.
